title: Retirement Discount — Marine Contractors
summary: An employer accelerates an employee’s enjoyment of a retirement-related benefit in connection with an undertaking not to compete.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Identify what right the employee already had, what earlier or additional enjoyment the employer promised, and whether that change was bargained for. Does the presence of a pre-existing benefit eliminate every possible new exchange? The problem points to Marine Contractors Co. v. Hurley.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
